Hi Simon — thanks, received. A few quick clarifications so we can proceed with PO creation and activation: 

1) Certificate holder: please list exactly — "Redwood Inference, Inc., 220 Montgomery St, San Francisco, CA 94104" on the COI.
2) Additional insured: we require GL to name Redwood Inference as Additional Insured for operations and products-completed operations.
3) Waiver of subrogation: preferred but not blocking; flag if carrier cannot provide.
4) Cyber limits: $2M is acceptable for now but if your SSO/access model includes contractor admin rights we may escalate to $5M — security will advise.

Stephanie — can you confirm PO numbering sequence and whether we can include a short payment term (Net 30) on the PO?

Simon — once we have the COI with the holder and additional insured endorsement, procurement will issue PO and route a DocuSign MSA for signature. We typically attach the PO to the DocuSign envelope so our records show both.

Thanks,
